meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided to give Owen a zero, and why did he find out from his phone in the middle of class?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
I'm writing that down. One wrong line proves a seventeen-year-old misremembered Shakespeare, Hale, not that he didn't write the essay. What else do you have?
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.

Choose your next sentence very carefully, Hale. Claire won her appeal, and you just told me "It seems to run in the family," which is going word for word to the principal tonight. The zero comes off and I get an apology, or I'm walking upstairs right now.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that he receive an apology, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, agreeing to nothing, after the mention of Claire pushed her back and toward the principal.
What moved her: nothing; the misquoted Hamlet line earned a small sign of ground but was undated and not enough to shift her position.
